# TEST FIXTURES for the ad loader — NOT a production key

`TEST-ONLY-private.key` is a throw-away Ed25519 key that exists ONLY for unit and e2e tests
(vitest signs manifests with it, `?adkey=` in the test build `dist-adtest` trusts its public half
`TEST-ONLY-public.key`). The release build never trusts it (PLAT-012). The production key is
generated by the owner with `tools/ads/keygen.py` and is never stored in the repository.

`ads/` holds a manifest signed by `tools/ads/sign.py` with this key over tiny test images
(`template.json`), regenerate with:

    python3 tools/ads/sign.py --key web/tests/fixtures/ads/TEST-ONLY-private.key \
      --template web/tests/fixtures/ads/template.json --ads-dir web/tests/fixtures/ads/ads \
      --version 5 --valid-days 36500 --now 2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00
